news.text: Add GO-3 Nano Preview co-train results (88.54 / 81.48%).
Add PrismWAM (87.98 / 53.16%) and PrismWAM* (91.84 / 75.50%) co-train results.
Rename OLA-Sem to UniWAM. Add Discrete Forcing co-train results (59.32 / 11.20%).
Add OpenWAM-α RoboDojo sim (17.18 / 11.92%) and real (37.6 / 24.4%) results.
Add OLA-Geo and UniWAM co-train results.
Add Average（c2c+c2r） ranking as the default board sort.
Add/update Spatial Forcing, starVLA, Abot-M0, and GalaxeaVLA co-train results.
Add GigaBrain-0.7 co-train results (50 demo_clean × 50 tasks).
Merge Co-train + Single-task SFT into one clean2random board; add Easy/Hard ranking.
Support RDT, π0, ACT, DP, and DP3 single-task SFT results.
